pack_call.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若其力量为6或更高，将其置于牌库顶。否则，将其置于牌库底。
pack_call.text_en: When this defends, reveal the top card of your deck. If it has 6 or more {p}, put it on top. Otherwise, put it on the bottom.

paddle_faster.type_zh: 海盗 Necromancer 行动·攻击
paddle_faster.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以横置你控制的一个盟友。若如此做，此牌获得再动。
paddle_faster.text_en: When this attacks, you may {t} an ally you control. If you do, this gets go again.

pain_in_the_backside.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 行动·攻击
pain_in_the_backside.text_zh:
当此牌命中英雄时，你控制的目标匕首对其造成1点伤害。若以此方式造成伤害，该匕首视为命中。
再动
pain_in_the_backside.text_en:
When this hits a hero, target dagger you control deals 1 damage to them. If damage is dealt this way, the dagger has hit.
Go again

painful_passage.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动
painful_passage.text_zh:
你可以放逐你手牌中的一张攻击行动牌。若如此做，它直到回合结束获得+3力量或再动。
再动
painful_passage.text_en:
You may banish an attack action card from your hand. If you do, it gets +3{p} or go again until end of turn.
Go again

painful_premonition.text_zh:
对任意目标造成3点秘法伤害。
若此牌造成伤害，创造一个命运印记衍生物。
painful_premonition.text_en:
Deal 3 arcane damage to any target.
If this deals damage, create a Sigil of Fate token.

palantir_aeronought.text_zh:
防御英雄若能够，必须用其控制的一件装备防御此牌。
每回合三次瞬间——横置你控制的一个齿轮：此牌获得+1力量。若这是你第三次启动此异能，摧毁一张防御牌。
palantir_aeronought.text_en:
The defending hero must defend this with an equipment they control if able.
Thrice per Turn Instant - {t} a cog you control: This gets +1{p}. If this is the third time you've activated this ability, destroy a defending card.

panel_beater.text_zh:
推进
此牌获得+X力量，X为防御它的装备数量。
panel_beater.text_en:
Boost
This gets +X{p}, where X is the number of equipment defending it.

parable_of_humility.type_zh: 光 幻术师 瞬间·光环
parable_of_humility.text_zh:
你对手控制的攻击行动牌在攻击和防御时获得-1力量。
幻尊
parable_of_humility.text_en:
Attack action cards your opponents control get -1{p} while attacking and defending.
Spectra

paragon_plate.text_zh:
攻击反应——横置此牌，从你控制的一把攻击中的剑上移除一个+1力量指示物：获得1点资源。
淬炼
paragon_plate.text_en:
Attack Reaction - {t}, remove a +1{p} counter from an attacking sword you control: Gain {r}
Temper

parched_terrain.text_zh:
英雄不能获得生命。
在你的结束阶段开始时，在此牌上放置一个沙指示物，然后除非你为其上的每个沙指示物将一张红色牌从你的坟场放逐，否则摧毁它。
parched_terrain.text_en:
Heroes can't gain {h}.
At the beginning of your end phase, put a sand counter on this, then destroy it unless you banish a red card from your graveyard for each sand counter on it.

parry_blade.type_zh: Warror 武器 装备·剑 （单手）
parry_blade.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击
当防御武器攻击时，此牌获得+2防御。
刃碎
parry_blade.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack
This gets +2{d} while defending a weapon attack.
Blade Break

pass_over.text_zh:
传奇
放逐一位对手英雄坟场中的目标牌。
若本回合你使用过另一张蓝色牌，超越。
pass_over.text_en:
Legendary
Banish target card from an opposing hero's graveyard.
If you've played another blue card this turn, transcend.

passing_mirage.text_zh:
你每回合的第一次幻术师攻击失去且不能获得虚击。
幻尊
passing_mirage.text_en:
Your first Illusionist attack each turn loses and can't get phantasm.
Spectra

patch_the_hole.text_zh: 瞬间——摧毁此牌：将你军械库中的一张牌移回你的手牌。
patch_the_hole.text_en: Instant - Destroy this: Return a card from your arsenal to your hand.

path_of_same_ends.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动·攻击
path_of_same_ends.text_zh:
当此牌攻击英雄时，对其造成1点秘法伤害。若以此方式造成伤害，此牌获得再动。
瞬间——支付1点资源：此牌获得再动。
path_of_same_ends.text_en:
When this attacks a hero, deal 1 arcane damage to them. If damage is dealt this way, this gets go again.
Instant - {r}: This gets go again.

path_of_vengeance.text_zh:
攻击反应——摧毁此牌：目标正在攻击阿拉克尼的攻击获得再动。
刃碎
path_of_vengeance.text_en:
Attack Reaction - Destroy this: Target attack that is attacking Arakni gets go again.
Blade Break

path_well_traveled.text_zh:
传奇
目标攻击获得再动。
若本回合你使用过另一张蓝色牌，超越。
path_well_traveled.text_en:
Legendary
Target attack gets go again.
If you've played another blue card this turn, transcend.

pathing_helix.type_zh: 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
pathing_helix.text_zh: 若路径螺旋命中且你军械库中没有牌，你可以将你手牌中的一张牌牌面朝下放入你的军械库。
pathing_helix.text_en: If Pathing Helix hits and you have no cards in your arsenal, you may put a card from your hand face down into your arsenal.

pay_day.text_zh: 若本回合你完成过一份契约，创造4个银币衍生物。
pay_day.text_en: If you've completed a contract this turn, create 4 Silver tokens.

pay_up.text_zh:
若防御英雄控制一个金币，此牌获得压制。
当此牌命中英雄时，获得其控制的一个金币衍生物的控制权。若你没有，对其造成1点伤害。
pay_up.text_en:
If defending hero controls a Gold, this gets overpower.
When this hits a hero, gain control of a Gold token they control. If you don't, deal 1 damage to them.

payload.text_zh: 若本战斗链中你推进过，有效载荷获得支配。
payload.text_en: If you have boosted this combat chain, Payload gains dominate.

peace_of_mind.text_zh:
本回合接下来你将受到伤害时，防止其中4点伤害。
创造一个沉思衍生物。
peace_of_mind.text_en:
The next time you would be dealt {p} damage, prevent 4 of that damage.
Create a Ponder token.

peaceful_sanctuary.text_zh:
英雄不能创造光环衍生物。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌。
peaceful_sanctuary.text_en:
Heroes can't create aura tokens.
At the start of your action phase, destroy this.

pearl_amulet.text_zh:
行动——摧毁此牌：重置目标永久物。再动
水葬传说
pearl_amulet.text_en:
Action - Destroy this: {u} target permanent. Go again
Legend of the Watery Grave

pec_perfect.text_zh: 每当牌防御此牌时，与防御英雄交锋。胜者摧毁另一位英雄牌库顶的一张牌。
pec_perfect.text_en: Whenever a card defends this, clash with the defending hero. The winner destroys the top card of the other hero's deck.

pedal_to_the_metal.text_zh:
若踩油门到底命中，你本回合的下一次攻击获得支配。
推进
pedal_to_the_metal.text_en:
If Pedal to the Metal hits, your next attack this turn gains dominate.
Boost

peg_leg.text_zh:
行动——支付3点资源，摧毁此牌：你本回合的下一次攻击获得再动。再动。
刃碎
peg_leg.text_en:
Action - {r}{r}{r}, destroy this: Your next attack this turn gets go again. Go again.
Blade Break

pendulum_trap.type_zh: 游侠 防御反应·陷阱
pendulum_trap.text_zh: 当此牌防御且攻击英雄在此链环中使用或启动过反应时，将其牌库顶的2张牌置入其坟场。
pendulum_trap.text_en: When this defends and the attacking hero has played or activated a reaction this chain link, put the top 2 cards of their deck into their graveyard.

penetration_script.text_zh:
上弦
此牌进入竞技场时带有一个蒸汽指示物。在你的回合开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物，否则摧毁它。
你的机械师攻击行动牌获得+1力量。
penetration_script.text_en:
Crank
This enters the arena with a steam counter. At the start of your turn, destroy this unless you remove a steam counter from it.
Your Mechanologist attack action cards get +1{p}.

perch_grapplers.text_zh:
行动——支付2点资源，摧毁高台抓钩：直到回合结束，从军械库使用的正面朝上的箭矢牌获得再动。再动
刃碎
perch_grapplers.text_en:
Action - {r}{r}, destroy Perch Grapplers: Until end of turn, face up arrow cards played from arsenal gain go again. Go again
Blade Break

perennial_aetherbloom.text_zh:
对目标英雄造成3点秘法伤害。
激涌——若此牌造成超过3点伤害，将其置于其拥有者的牌库底。
perennial_aetherbloom.text_en:
Deal 3 arcane damage to target hero.
Surge - If this deals more than 3 damage, put it on the bottom of its owner's deck.

perforate.type_zh: 刺客·战士 攻击反应
perforate.text_zh:
本回合你可以用目标匕首额外攻击一次，且其攻击启动费用减少1点资源。
抽一张牌。
perforate.text_en:
You may attack with target dagger an additional time and its attacks cost you {r} less to activate this turn.
Draw a card.

performance_bonus.text_zh:
当此牌命中时，创造一个金币衍生物。
若此牌是从军械库使用的，它获得再动。
performance_bonus.text_en:
When this hits, create a Gold token.
If this was played from arsenal, it gets Go again.

perk_up.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次机械师攻击获得+4力量。
你可以重置你的英雄。
再动
perk_up.text_en:
Your next Mechanologist attack this turn gets +4{p}.
You may {u} your hero.
Go again

persuasive_prognosis.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。然后查看其手牌并放逐一张与被放逐的牌同色的牌。
每当此牌放逐一张行动牌时，获得1点生命。
persuasive_prognosis.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck. Then look at their hand and banish a card with the same color as the banished card.
Whenever this banishes an action card, gain 1{h}.

phantasmaclasm.text_zh:
查看防御英雄的手牌并选择一张牌。该英雄将其置于其牌库底，然后抽一张牌。
虚击
phantasmaclasm.text_en:
Look at the defending hero's hand and choose a card. They put it on the bottom of their deck then draw a card.
Phantasm

phantasmal_footsteps.text_zh:
每回合一次，当你控制的幻术师攻击行动牌被摧毁时，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，获得1个行动点。
每当此牌防御时，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，直到回合结束它的防御变为1。
当幻象脚步防御力量为6或更高的非幻术师攻击时，当战斗链关闭时摧毁它。
phantasmal_footsteps.text_en:
Once per turn, when an Illusionist attack action card you control is destroyed, you may pay {r}. If you do, gain 1 action point.
Whenever this defends, you may pay {r}. If you do, its {d} becomes 1 until end of turn.
When Phantasmal Footsteps is defending a non-Illusionist attack with 6 or more {p}, destroy it when the combat chain closes.

phantasmal_haze.text_zh:
虚击
当虚击雾霭被摧毁时，创造一个幻质护盾衍生物。
phantasmal_haze.text_en:
Phantasm
When Phantasmal Haze is destroyed, create a Spectral Shield token.

phantasmal_symbiosis.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，说出一张牌名。直到回合结束，具有该名称的牌视为幻术师。
虚击
phantasmal_symbiosis.text_en:
When this attacks, name a card.  Cards with that name are Illusionist until end of turn.
Phantasm

phantasmify.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌除其原有职业类别外还视为幻术师，并获得+5力量和虚击。
再动
phantasmify.text_en:
The next attack action card you play this turn is Illusionist in addition to its other class types, and gains +5{p} and phantasm.
Go again

phantom_tidemaw.text_zh:
每当你控制的幻术师牌被摧毁时，在此牌上放置一个+1力量指示物。
虚击
结界1
phantom_tidemaw.text_en:
Whenever an Illusionist card you control is destroyed, put a +1{p} counter on this.
Phantasm
Ward 1

phoenix_bannerman_arms.text_zh:
传奇
从你的牌库中搜寻一张凤凰烈焰，展示它，将其置入你的手牌，然后洗牌。
创造一个力量衍生物。
再动
phoenix_bannerman_arms.text_en:
Legendary
Search your deck for a Phoenix Flame, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
Create a Might token.
Go again

phoenix_bannerman_chest.text_zh:
传奇
从你的牌库中搜寻一张凤凰烈焰，展示它，将其置入你的手牌，然后洗牌。
创造一个活力衍生物。
再动
phoenix_bannerman_chest.text_en:
Legendary
Search your deck for a Phoenix Flame, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
Create a Vigor token.
Go again

phoenix_bannerman_head.text_zh:
传奇
从你的牌库中搜寻一张凤凰烈焰，展示它，将其置入你的手牌，然后洗牌。
创造一个沉思衍生物。
再动
phoenix_bannerman_head.text_en:
Legendary
Search your deck for a Phoenix Flame, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
Create a Ponder token.
Go again

phoenix_bannerman_legs.text_zh:
传奇
从你的牌库中搜寻一张凤凰烈焰，展示它，将其置入你的手牌，然后洗牌。
创造一个敏捷衍生物。
再动
phoenix_bannerman_legs.text_en:
Legendary
Search your deck for a Phoenix Flame, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
Create an Agility token.
Go again

phoenix_flame.text_zh:
若你控制2个或更多龙裔链环，此牌获得+1力量。
再动
phoenix_flame.text_en:
If you control 2 or more Draconic chain links, this gets +1{p}.
Go again

phoenix_form.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
phoenix_form.text_zh: 若你控制1张或更多凤凰烈焰，凤凰形态具有再动。若你控制2张或更多，它获得+2力量。若你控制3张或更多，它获得“当此牌命中英雄时，抽3张牌。”
phoenix_form.text_en: If you control 1 or more Phoenix Flames, Phoenix Form has go again. If you control 2 or more, it has +2{p}. If you control 3 or more, it has "When this hits a hero, draw 3 cards."

photon_rush.type_zh: 元素 符文剑士 行动·攻击
photon_rush.text_zh: 闪电流转——若本回合你使用过一张闪电牌，此牌获得再动。
photon_rush.text_en: Lightning Flow - If you've played a Lightning card this turn, this gets go again

photon_splicing.text_zh:
对任意目标造成4点秘法伤害。
瞬间——弃掉此牌：增幅1
photon_splicing.text_en:
Deal 4 arcane damage to any target.
Instant - Discard this: Amp 1

pick_a_card_any_card.text_zh:
查看目标对手的手牌，然后说出一张牌名。
从其手牌中随机选择一张牌并展示它。若其为被说出的牌，创造一个银币衍生物。重复此过程三次。
再动
pick_a_card_any_card.text_en:
Look at target opponent's hand then name a card.
Choose a random card from their hand and reveal it. If it's the named card, create a Silver token. Repeat this process thrice.
Go again

pick_to_pieces.text_zh:
隐匿
若此链环中你使用或启动过攻击反应，此牌获得+1力量，以及“此牌将造成的伤害不能被防止。”
pick_to_pieces.text_en:
Stealth
If you've played or activated an attack reaction this chain link, this gets +1{p} and "Damage that would be dealt by this can't be prevented."

pick_up_the_point.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 行动·攻击
pick_up_the_point.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，你可以从你的坟场中回收一把匕首。
再动
pick_up_the_point.text_en:
When this attacks, you may retrieve a dagger from your graveyard.
Go again

pick_yourself_up_off_the_floor.name_en: Pick Yourself Up Off the Floor
pick_yourself_up_off_the_floor.text_zh: 将你坟场中的一张攻击行动牌置于你的牌库顶。若你的生命低于一位对手，改为将其置入你的手牌。
pick_yourself_up_off_the_floor.text_en: Put an attack action card from your graveyard on the top of your deck. If you have less {h} than an opponent, instead put it in your hand.

pierce_reality.text_zh:
你每回合使用的第一张幻术师攻击行动牌获得+2力量。
幻尊
pierce_reality.text_en:
Your first Illusionist attack action card you play each turn gets +2{p}.
Spectra

piercing_shadow_vise.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击
piercing_shadow_vise.text_zh:
你可以从你的放逐区使用贯穿暗影之钳。
若本回合你对对手英雄造成过秘法伤害，贯穿暗影之钳获得+2力量。
血债
piercing_shadow_vise.text_en:
You may play Piercing Shadow Vise from your banished zone.
If you have dealt arcane damage to an opposing hero this turn, Piercing Shadow Vise gains +2{p}.
Blood Debt

pile_driver.text_zh:
贝特西专精
行动——支付4点资源，横置此牌：攻击
当此牌攻击时，你可以与防御英雄以一个金币衍生物下注。
pile_driver.text_en:
Betsy Specialization
Action - {r}{r}{r}{r}, {t}: Attack
When this attacks, you may wager a Gold token with the defending hero.

pilfer_the_tomb.text_zh:
选择其一或全部；
放逐一位对手英雄坟场中的目标瞬间牌。
放逐一位对手英雄坟场中的目标黄色牌。

pilfer_the_wreck.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，你可以将其坟场中的一张牌翻为牌面朝下。若其为黄色，创造一个金币衍生物。
pilfer_the_wreck.text_en: When this hits a hero, you may turn a card in their graveyard face-down. If it's yellow, create a Gold token.

pillar_of_unity.text_zh:
团结——当此牌与一张来自手牌的牌一起防御时，此牌直到回合结束获得+1防御。
淬炼
pillar_of_unity.text_en:
Unity - When this defends together with a card from hand, this gets +1{d} until end of turn.
Temper

pinion_sentry.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，你可以横置你控制的一个齿轮。若如此做，创造一个金齿轮衍生物。
pinion_sentry.text_en: When this defends, you may {t} a cog you control. If you do, create a Golden Cog token.

pink_visor.text_zh:
鲁迪专精
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：本回合你展示的下一张牌的评级增加1级。再动
pink_visor.text_en:
Ruu'di Specialization
Once per Turn Action - {r}: The next card you reveal this turn has its grade increased by 1. Go again

pint_of_strong_and_stout.text_zh:
创造一个力量和一个活力衍生物。
再动
pint_of_strong_and_stout.text_en:
Create a Might and a Vigor token.
Go again

pitfall_trap.type_zh: 游侠 防御反应·陷阱
pitfall_trap.text_zh:
仅能从军械库使用陷阱。
当此牌防御时，对攻击英雄造成2点伤害，除非其支付1点资源。
pitfall_trap.text_en:
Pitfall Trap can only be played from arsenal.
When this defends, deal 2 damage to the attacking hero unless they pay {r}.

plague_hive.type_zh: 刺客·游侠 资源·宝石
plague_hive.text_zh:
传奇
当你将瘟疫蜂巢资源时，为每位对手英雄在惰性、虚弱或血腐疫病中随机选择一种，并在其控制下创造该衍生物。
plague_hive.text_en:
Legendary

每当行动阶段期间一张名称中含有先驱者的牌被置入棱镜的灵魂时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张幻象，将其放入竞技场，然后洗牌。
每回合一次瞬间——支付2点资源，放逐棱镜灵魂中的一张牌：唤醒你控制的目标幻象。
prism_advent_of_thrones.text_en:
Whenever a card with Herald in its name is put into Prism's soul during an action phase, you may search your deck for a figment, put it into the arena, then shuffle.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}, banish a card from Prism's soul: Awaken target figment you control.

prism_awakener_of_sol.text_zh:
每当行动阶段期间一张名称中含有先驱者的牌被置入棱镜的灵魂时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张幻象，将其放入竞技场，然后洗牌。
每回合一次瞬间——支付2点资源，放逐棱镜灵魂中的一张牌：唤醒你控制的目标幻象。
prism_awakener_of_sol.text_en:
Whenever a card with Herald in its name is put into Prism's soul during an action phase, you may search your deck for a figment, put it into the arena, then shuffle.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}, banish a card from Prism's soul: Awaken target figment you control.

prism_sculptor_of_arc_light.text_zh: 每回合一次瞬间——支付2点资源，放逐棱镜灵魂中的一张牌：创造一个幻质护盾衍生物。
prism_sculptor_of_arc_light.text_en: Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}, banish a card from Prism's soul: Create a Spectral Shield token.

prismatic_lens.text_zh:
上弦
此牌进入竞技场时带有一个蒸汽指示物。在你的回合开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物，否则摧毁它。
每回合一次瞬间——费用0：展示你牌库顶的一张牌。将你放逐区中一张同色的机械师物品置于你的牌库顶。
prismatic_lens.text_en:
Crank
This enters the arena with a steam counter. At the start of your turn, destroy this unless you remove a steam counter from it.
Once per Turn Instant - 0: Reveal the top card of your deck. Put a Mechanologist item of the same color from your banished zone on top of your deck.

prismatic_leyline.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次红色攻击获得+1力量，下一次黄色攻击获得+2力量，下一次蓝色攻击获得+3力量。
再动
prismatic_leyline.text_en:
Your next red attack this turn gets +1{p}, your next yellow gets +2{p}, and your next blue gets +3{p}.
Go again

prismatic_shield.text_zh: 创造3个幻质护盾衍生物。

prized_galea.text_zh:
奥林匹亚专精
攻击反应——支付1点资源，摧毁此牌：你控制的目标武器攻击与防御英雄以一个金币衍生物下注。
淬炼
prized_galea.text_en:
Olympia Specialization
Attack Reaction - {r}, destroy this: Target weapon attack you control wagers a Gold token with the defending hero.
Temper

prizeworn_gauntlet.text_zh:
每当你赢得一次下注时，你可以横置你的英雄并摧毁此牌。若如此做，创造一个勇气衍生物。
守御
prizeworn_gauntlet.text_en:
Whenever you win a wager, you may {t} your hero and destroy this. If you do, create a Courage token.
Guardwell

prizeworn_pathfinders.type_zh: 守护者·战士 装备·腿部
prizeworn_pathfinders.text_zh:
每当你赢得一次下注时，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，从你此牌上移除一个-1防御指示物。
战痕
prizeworn_pathfinders.text_en:
Whenever you win a wager, you may pay {r}. If you do, remove a -1{d} counter from this.
Battleworn

prizeworn_plating.text_zh:
每当你赢得一次下注时，你可以横置你的英雄并摧毁此牌。若如此做，创造一个活力衍生物。
守御
prizeworn_plating.text_en:
Whenever you win a wager, you may {t} your hero and destroy this. If you do, create a Vigor token.
Guardwell

proclaim_vengeance.text_zh: 标记目标对手英雄。若该英雄为阿拉克尼，获得1点资源。
proclaim_vengeance.text_en: Mark target opposing hero. If that hero is Arakni, gain {r}.

proclamation_of_abundance.text_zh: 行动——支付3点资源，摧毁此牌：每位英雄抽牌至其智力值。
proclamation_of_abundance.text_en: Action - {r}{r}{r}, destroy this: Each hero draws up to their {i}.

proclamation_of_combat.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：直到你的下一个回合开始，英雄只能使用或启动武器和攻击行动。
proclamation_of_combat.text_en: Action - Destroy this: Until the start of your next turn, the only actions heroes may play or activate are weapon and attack actions.

proclamation_of_production.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：每位英雄可以从其牌库中搜寻一张费用为0或1的物品，将其放入竞技场，然后洗牌。每位没有以此方式将物品放入竞技场的英雄弃一张牌。
proclamation_of_production.text_en: Action - Destroy this: Each hero may search their deck for an item with cost 0 or 1, put it into the arena, then shuffle. Each hero who doesn't put an item into the arena this way discards a card.

proclamation_of_requisition.text_zh: 行动——弃一张红色牌，摧毁征用宣言：每位对手选择其控制的一个物品或地标。获得所选永久物的控制权。
proclamation_of_requisition.text_en: Action - Discard a red card, destroy Proclamation of Requisition: Each opponent chooses an item or landmark they control. Gain control of the chosen permanents.

professor_teklovossen.text_zh:
每有一位对手英雄，进化牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
你可以从你的放逐区使用进化牌。
professor_teklovossen.text_en:
Evos cost {r} less to play for each opposing hero.
You may play Evos from your banished zone.

prognosticate.text_zh:
对目标英雄造成3点秘法伤害。
激涌——若此牌造成超过3点伤害，占卜1。
prognosticate.text_en:
Deal 3 arcane damage to target hero.
Surge - If this deals more than 3 damage, opt 1.

promise_of_plenty.text_zh:
若丰饶承诺命中，每位军械库中没有牌的英雄将其牌库顶的一张牌面朝下放入其军械库。
若丰饶承诺是从军械库使用的，它获得再动。
promise_of_plenty.text_en:
If Promise of Plenty hits, each hero who doesn't have a card in their arsenal puts the top card of their deck face down into their arsenal.
If Promise of Plenty is played from arsenal, it gains go again.

promising_terrain.text_zh:
再动
若你将创造1个或更多地震涌动衍生物，改为创造等量加1个。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌，然后若你控制3个或更多地震涌动衍生物，抽一张牌并获得1点生命。
promising_terrain.text_en:
Go again
If you would create 1 or more Seismic Surge tokens, instead create that many plus 1.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this, then if you control 3 or more Seismic Surge tokens, draw a card and gain 1{h}.

prophetic_quickstep.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动·攻击
prophetic_quickstep.text_zh:
速击——若此牌具有再动，它获得+1力量，以及“当此牌攻击英雄时，对其造成1点秘法伤害。”
此牌第一次对英雄造成伤害时，创造一个沉思衍生物。
prophetic_quickstep.text_en:
Quickstrike - If this has go again, it gets +1{p} and "When this attacks a hero, deal 1 arcane damage to them."
The first time this deals damage to a hero, create a Ponder token.

proto_base_arms.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 手臂

proto_base_chest.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 胸部

proto_base_head.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 头部

proto_base_legs.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 腿部

provoke.text_zh: 若你在此链环中用武器攻击，防御英雄展示其手牌中的一张牌。若其为行动牌，将其作为防御牌加入此链环，否则该英雄弃掉它。
provoke.text_en: If you're attacking with a weapon this chain link, the defending hero reveals a card from their hand. If it's an action card, add it to this chain link as a defending card, otherwise they discard it.

prowess_of_agility.text_zh:
当你在一个回合中第四次攻击时，你可以摧毁此牌。若如此做，抽一张牌。
在你的结束阶段开始时，若本回合你攻击少于3次，摧毁此牌。
prowess_of_agility.text_en:
When you attack for the fourth time during a turn, you may destroy this. If you do, draw a card.
At the beginning of your end phase, if you've attacked less than 3 times this turn, destroy this.

prowl.text_zh:
隐匿
本战斗链中你使用的下一张具有隐匿的攻击获得+1力量。
prowl.text_en:
Stealth
The next attack with stealth you play this combat chain gains +1{p}.

pry.text_zh:
目标英雄展示其手牌中的3张牌。若撬开是在对手的回合期间使用的，改为该英雄展示其手牌中的所有牌。
你可以选择一张以此方式展示的牌。若如此做，该英雄将其置于其牌库底，然后抽一张牌。
pry.text_en:
Target hero reveals 3 cards from their hand. If Pry is played during an opponents turn, instead they reveal all cards in their hand.
You may choose a card revealed this way. If you do, that hero puts it on the bottom of their deck then draws a card.

public_bounty.text_zh:
标记目标对手英雄。
本回合你下一次攻击被标记的英雄时，该攻击获得+3力量。
再动
public_bounty.text_en:
Mark target opposing hero.
The next time you attack a marked hero this turn, the attack gets +3{p}.
Go again

puffer_jacket.text_zh:
你控制的非衍生物超频驱动器进入竞技场时带有一个额外的蒸汽指示物。
淬炼
puffer_jacket.text_en:
Non-token Hyper Drivers you control enter the arena with an additional steam counter.
Temper

puffin.text_zh:
行动——横置此牌，摧毁你控制的一个金币：创造一个金齿轮衍生物。
你每回合第二次上弦时，抽一张牌。
puffin.text_en:
Action - {t}, destroy a Gold you control: Create a Golden Cog token.
The second time you crank each turn, draw a card.

puffin_hightail.text_zh:
行动——横置此牌，摧毁你控制的一个金币：创造一个金齿轮衍生物。
你每回合第二次上弦时，抽一张牌。
puffin_hightail.text_en:
Action - {t}, destroy a Gold you control: Create a Golden Cog token.
The second time you crank each turn, draw a card.

pulping.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，抽一张牌，然后随机弃一张牌。若以此方式弃置的是力量为6或更高的牌，此牌获得支配。
若此牌被少于2张非装备牌防御，它获得再动。
pulping.text_en:
When this attacks, draw a card then discard a random card. If a card with 6 or more {p} is discarded this way, this gets dominate.
If this is defended by fewer than 2 non-equipment cards, it gets go again.

pulse_of_candlehold.type_zh: 大地 闪电 行动
pulse_of_candlehold.text_zh:
传奇
将你坟场中的至多2张目标大地、闪电和/或元素行动牌置于你的牌库顶。放逐烛火之脉冲。
再动
pulse_of_candlehold.text_en:
Legendary
Put up to 2 target Earth, Lightning and/or Elemental action cards from your graveyard on top of your deck. Banish Pulse of Candlehold.
Go again

pulse_of_isenloft.text_zh:
传奇
大地、冰和元素行动牌在本回合防御时获得+1防御。
pulse_of_isenloft.text_en:
Legendary
Earth, Ice, and Elemental action cards have +1{d} while defending this turn.

pulse_of_volthaven.text_zh:
传奇
你本回合的下一次冰、闪电或元素攻击获得+4力量。
pulse_of_volthaven.text_en:
Legendary
Your next Ice, Lightning, or Elemental attack this turn gains +4{p}.

pulsewave_harpoon.text_zh:
当此牌攻击英雄时，该英雄展示其手牌中的X张牌，X为本战斗链中你推进的次数。选择一张防御小于或等于X的行动牌，然后将其作为防御牌加入此链环。
推进
pulsewave_harpoon.text_en:
When this attacks a hero, they reveal X cards from their hand, where X is the number of times you've boosted this combat chain. Choose an action card with {d} less than or equal to X, then add it to this chain link as a defending card.
Boost

pulsewave_protocol.text_zh: 进化升级——当此牌攻击英雄时，该英雄展示其手牌中的X张牌，X为你已装备的进化装备数量。选择一张防御小于X的行动牌，然后将其作为防御牌加入此链环。
pulsewave_protocol.text_en: Evo Upgrade - When this attacks a hero, they reveal X cards from their hand, where X is the number of Evos you have equipped. Choose an action card with {d} less than X, then add it to this chain link as a defending card.

pulsing_aether_life.type_zh: 法师 行动·大地 瞬间
pulsing_aether_life.text_zh:
凝合
对任意目标造成4点秘法伤害。
//
获得1点生命。

pulsing_cardia.type_zh: 闪电 幻术师 行动·攻击
pulsing_cardia.text_zh:
每当此牌碎片化时，获得1点资源。
碎片

pulverize.text_zh:
重掷3
若粉碎命中英雄，该英雄在其下一个回合期间的第一次攻击获得-4力量。
pulverize.text_en:
Heave 3
If Pulverize hits a hero, their first attack during their next turn has -4{p}.

pummel.text_zh:
选择其一；
- 目标棒或锤武器攻击获得+4力量。
- 目标费用为2或更高的攻击行动牌获得+4力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄弃一张牌。”

punch_above_your_weight.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以支付3点资源。若如此做，此牌获得+5力量。
punch_above_your_weight.text_en: When this attacks, you may pay {r}{r}{r}. If you do, this gets +5{p}.

punching_gloves.text_zh: 行动——支付2点资源，摧毁此牌：你本回合使用的下一张攻击牌获得+2力量。再动
punching_gloves.text_en: Action - {r}{r}, destroy this: The next attack card you play this turn gets +2{p}. Go again

puncture.text_zh: 目标剑或匕首攻击获得+3力量和穿透1。
puncture.text_en: Target sword or dagger attack gains +3{p} and piercing 1.

pursue_to_the_edge_of_oblivion.name_en: Pursue to the Edge of Oblivion
pursue_to_the_edge_of_oblivion.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，标记该英雄。
pursue_to_the_edge_of_oblivion.text_en: When this hits a hero, mark them.

pursue_to_the_pits_of_despair.name_en: Pursue to the Pits of Despair
pursue_to_the_pits_of_despair.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，标记该英雄。
pursue_to_the_pits_of_despair.text_en: When this hits a hero, mark them.

pursuit_of_knowledge.text_zh: 当此牌命中时，你的英雄直到回合结束获得+1智力。
pursuit_of_knowledge.text_en: When this hits, your hero gets +1{i} until end of turn.

push_forward.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次武器攻击获得+3力量。
若本回合你用武器攻击过，你本回合的下一次攻击获得支配。
再动
push_forward.text_en:
Your next weapon attack this turn gets +3{p}.
If you've attacked with a weapon this turn, your next attack this turn gets dominate.
Go again

push_the_point.text_zh: 若此战斗链上的最后一次攻击命中，强调重点获得+2力量。
push_the_point.text_en: If the last attack on this combat chain hit, Push the Point gains +2{p}.

put_em_in_their_place.text_zh:
瓦尔达专精
粉碎——当此牌对英雄造成4点或更多伤害时，该英雄弃掉其手牌，然后抽等量的牌。
put_em_in_their_place.text_en:
Valda Specialization
Crush - When this deals 4 or more damage to a hero, they discard their hand, then they draw that many cards.

put_in_context.text_zh: 此牌只能防御基础力量为3或更低的攻击。
put_in_context.text_en: This can only defend an attack with 3 or less base {p}.

put_on_ice.text_zh:
冻结至多3个目标盟友，直到你的下一个回合开始。
若此牌是从军械库使用的，抽一张牌。
再动
put_on_ice.text_en:
Freeze up to 3 target allies until the start of your next turn.
If this was played from arsenal, draw a card.
Go again

putrid_stirrings.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动
putrid_stirrings.text_zh:
你可以从你的放逐区使用此牌。
本回合你符文之门的下一次攻击行动牌获得+5力量。
再动
血债
putrid_stirrings.text_en:
You may play this from your banished zone.
The next attack action card you rune gate this turn gets +5{p}.
Go again
Blood debt

pyroglyphic_protection.text_zh:
若你的英雄将受到秘法伤害，防止该来源将造成的3点秘法伤害。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁焰刻防护。
pyroglyphic_protection.text_en:
If your hero would be dealt arcane damage, prevent 3 arcane damage that source would deal.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy Pyroglyphic Protection.
